description: Synthetic retrieval baseline; not a simulation of UI, agent reasoning or a productivity score.

cases.body: Pagination uses an opaque cursor. Resume by testing cursor expiry.
Invoice delivery retries must reuse the original idempotency key.
Authentication uses an HttpOnly cookie. Add a SameSite regression test next.
All worktrees of the same repository share the canonical project identity.
Database writes use explicit transactions to keep event and receipt atomic.
The current queue capacity decision is 64 MiB. The older 128 MiB proposal was rejected.
The hook timeout diagnosis found a missing child working directory. Set cwd before launching.
foreignprojectcanary belongs only to the other project.
Offline fallback must keep the composer available while memory requests fail.
Handoff selection must transmit the exact chosen identifier.
Restart recovery reopens the existing outbox and preserves event identifiers.
A background notification is status, not a new user request. Resume the original task.
